select T1.BASE_RULE_ID baseRuleId, T1.EFF_DATE effDate, T1.RATE_TYPE rateType, T1.RATE rate, T1.INDEX_ID indexId, T1.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, T1.COEFFICIENT coefficient, T1.SPREAD_RATE spreadRate, T1.RESET_TYPE resetType, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.BRANCH branch, T1.REMARK remark, T1.CREATE_USER createUser, T1.CREATE_DEPT createDept, T1.CREATE_TIME createTime, T1.UPDATE_USER updateUser, T1.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, T1.BASE_RULE_TYPE baseRuleType, T1.PUBLISH_TYPE publishType, T1.RATE_LOWER rateLower, T1.RATE_LIMIT rateLimit from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T1 where T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and T1.BASE_RULE_TYPE = '01' and EFF_DATE = (select max(T2.EFF_DATE) from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO T2 where T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and T2.BASE_RULE_TYPE = '01'
and T2.EFF_DATE <= #{paramDate,jdbcType=DATE} )

and T.EFF_DATE <= #{paramDate,jdbcType=DATE} )

select MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION.CLOSE_PRICE closePrice from MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION where 1=1 and MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION.MARKET_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION.MARKET_DATE = (select max(T.MARKET_DATE) from MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION T where T.MARKET_ID = MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION.MARKET_ID

select MST_INDEX_COMPONENT.COMPONENT_ID componentId, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT.COMPONENT_TYPE componentType, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT.WEIGHT weight from MST_INDEX_COMPONENT where MST_INDEX_COMPONENT.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select sum(FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.YIELD) yield from FIN_CASH_INFO inner join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE on FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = (select max(T.EFF_DATE) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T where T.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID
and T.EFF_DATE <= #{paramDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) where FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = 0 and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = '03' and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 != 'C04'

select max(FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE) payCycle from FIN_CASH_INFO inner join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE on FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.EFF_DATE = (select max(T.EFF_DATE) from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE T where T.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID
and T.EFF_DATE <= #{paramDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) where FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = 0 and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = '01'

select max(FIN_RATE_INFO.BASIS) basis from FIN_CASH_INFO inner join FIN_RATE_INFO on FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_RATE_INFO.CASH_ID and FIN_RATE_INFO.EFF_DATE = (select max(T.EFF_DATE) from FIN_RATE_INFO T where T.CASH_ID = FIN_RATE_INFO.CASH_ID
and T.EFF_DATE <= #{paramDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) where FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and FIN_CASH_INFO.BRANCH = 0 and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = '01'
